newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanians clash with police in land dispute.
newsitem.headline: Albanians clash with police in land dispute.

text.p: Albanian police on Tuesday clashed with some 200 people trying to block a major road in a protest over land ownership, the Interior Ministry said.
Four protesters and five policemen were injured in scuffles when police tried to remove barricades and trees in the road in a suburb of Tirana, Albanian television quoted the ministry as saying.
The demonstration was mounted after Tirana city hall awarded land as compensation to two people involved in a property ownership dispute and ordered three families already living there to leave.
Twenty people were arrested after police broke up the three-hour protest, the television said.
